name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I've spent the last eight years as a patient managing a chronic condition, working through prior authorizations and appeals to get treatment approved. I know firsthand how much depends on a primary care team having the right information in front of them during the visit, which is why Counterpart Assistant caught my attention. Implementation is the work I know best: at Wix I launched 25+ clients a month with up to 25 in flight, at 110% of my implementation target.

The parts of this role I'd step into fastest are running parallel launches and catching integration problems before they hit the target date. At Accelo I built sequenced implementation plans, deciding which systems to change and in what order. At Solenzo I diagnose integration failures myself, down to the webhook, API call, or JSON payload. At Fetch & Funnel I rebuilt handoff processes that cut errors between teams, the same kind of playbook work you describe.

Where I'd be learning is EHR integrations with provider practices specifically. My healthcare background is on the commercial side: four years at Senior Directory, a company focused on healthcare for seniors, and channel work with healthcare-focused agencies at Birdeye. I pick up new systems quickly and would welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
